Tamil Nadu CM Appoints Film Producer as Delhi Representative

Tamil Nadu Chief Minister M.K. Stalin has appointed the producer of the film 'Jana Nayagan' as the state's special representative in Delhi. This appointment aims to facilitate the state's affairs and coordination in the national capital. The move has been reported by various media outlets.
